blocks.translation:
△ Caution — Please read before use.
● This product is intended for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children below the recommended age.
● This product contains small parts and button batteries. Keep out of reach of small children to prevent accidental swallowing. There is a risk of choking and other hazards.
● The product has pointed or sharp parts; take care when handling and storing to avoid unexpected injury.
● This product uses electronic components; people with pacemakers should exercise caution.
● Do not use it near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing.
● Do not stare at flashing LED lights. Prolonged viewing may cause discomfort.
《Improper battery use can cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:》
● If a button battery is swallowed, or if battery fluid gets into the eyes, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
● Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of the reach of children.
● Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
● Insert batteries with the correct polarity (+/−).
● Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or dispose of batteries in fire.
● Dispose of batteries according to your local municipality's waste disposal regulations.
